title: LINGUAMAP: WHICH LAYERS OF LLMS SPEAK YOUR LANGUAGE AND HOW TO TUNE THEM?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language consistency using four zero-shot prompt variants (monolingual, code-switched, bilingual answer, and English distractor) across multiple languages, and probing internal representations via layer-wise logit lens decoding and hidden state cosine similarity to detect latent English-centric reasoning.
